title: Build a Local-first Feed Repository
prompt: Expose Room-only feed reads with ETag and TTL metadata, deduplicated refresh, 304 handling, stale content, cache eviction, and preserved bookmarks.
successCriteria: Presentation has one source of truth.
Older refresh cannot overwrite newer state.
Stale and failed refresh states retain usable local content.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class OfflineFirstNewsRepository(private val db: NewsDatabase, private val remote: NewsRemoteSource, private val clock: Clock)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
